message: ابني عمره خمس سنوات. يصرخ عندما أوقف الجهاز، ثم أعيده له فيهدأ. يحدث هذا يوميًا ولا يؤذي نفسه. ماذا أفعل؟

Title: Transition support guide
Publisher: Approved Rafiq clinical team
Evidence level: professional_guideline
Content: Use predictable transition warnings, a clear next activity, brief calm language, and consistent follow-through. Measure duration and recovery across several comparable transitions.

Title: Early communication support
Publisher: Approved speech-language team
Evidence level: professional_guideline
Content: Model short functional words during motivating routines, accept gestures while pairing them with language, avoid pressuring repetition, and recommend hearing and speech-language assessment when expressive communication is substantially limited for age.
